initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of 0.10, but the arithmetic checks do not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R214-1 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 0.10, but adoption was observational. Consistency and no interference alone do not identify the average causal effect; no additional identifying condition is supplied.
